The test image shows a soybean leaf with:
- Dark brown/black irregular lesions, some angular (vein-bounded)
- Yellow/chlorotic halos around lesions
- Water-soaked appearance on some areas
- Necrotic tissue along margins
- Scattered spots across the leaf

Top candidates: Bacterial_Blight (angular, water-soaked lesions with yellow halos), Bacterial_Pustule, Frogeye_leaf_spot, Septoria_brown_spot. Let me view reference images.

The Bacterial_Pustule reference shows scattered dark spots with yellow halos — quite similar to the test image. But the test image also has angular/water-soaked areas suggesting Bacterial_Blight. Let me view a few more to compare.
None of those match — Cercospora shows purple blotches, Anthracnose shows pod/stem lesions, Downy mildew shows white growth. Let me compare a few more close candidates.
Key observation on **Phyllosticta_leaf_spot** (top-left panel): shows dark spots with yellow chlorotic areas — very similar to the test image. Let me compare directly with Bacterial_Pustule again.

Now I have enough to make my assessment.

**Analysis:**

- **Test image features**: Scattered dark brown/black spots with prominent yellow/chlorotic halos, on a mostly green soybean leaf. Some angular/irregular marginal necrosis on the right edge.

- **Bacterial_Pustule** (bottom-right panel): Shows exactly this pattern — scattered dark spots with clear yellow halos on a green leaf. The spot size, density, and halo pattern match closely.

- **Bacterial_Blight**: Reference shows lighter tan/brown angular lesions that are more water-soaked and vein-bounded — somewhat similar but spots in test image are darker and more circular with prominent yellow halos.

- **Phyllosticta_leaf_spot**: Shows some similar dark spots with yellow areas, but also shows shot-hole (tissue dropout) which is not seen in the test image.

- **Septoria, Cercospora, Frogeye, SDS, Diaporthe, Downy mildew**: None match the pattern of scattered dark spots with yellow halos on a green leaf.

The combination of dark punctate spots with conspicuous yellow halos scattered across a green leaf is the hallmark presentation of **Bacterial_Pustule**.

This matches the Bacterial_Pustule reference closely (especially the bottom-right panel showing spot size, density, and yellow halo pattern). Bacterial_Blight is a secondary candidate but its reference shows lighter, more purely angular water-soaked lesions rather than the dark circular spots with halos seen here."}
